_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: RED: with a real new production duplicate, the guard passes (ratchet promise absent)
expectedRed.why: On correct code the ratchet bites on a real new production duplicate and fails the guard, so the assertion that the guard passes fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the ratchet promise (bite on growth) is absent again.
